table.name: TLGNC_IUD_COST
table.description: Interunit-Distribution costs for ALL materials if transported between a production and supply cost, fix per delivery. This cost element is used in the margin calculation of an order/order_item when the supply-plant (i.e. of the shippingpoint where it's loaded) differs from the production-plant (i.e. the plant where the material was originally produced). It is currently not required to express these costs material specific (introduce tlgnc_iud_mat_cost if needed); they are the same for all materials. Also, not variable costs (dependent on the quantity, based on the standard UOM of each material) are currently supported.

column.name: FROM_PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. The 'from' plant in an IUD order, i.e. the production plant. Part 1 of the alternative identifier/unique constraint.

column.name: TO_PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. The 'to' plant in an IUD order, i.e. the supply plant. Part 2 of the alternative identifier/unique constraint.

column.name: UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of Measurement. The costs are expressed per 1 UOM. UOM_CD is mandatory, part 3 of the alternative identifier/unique constraint! 'Per delivery' fixed costs (trying to set UOM_CD to NULL) are NOT supported because it is unclear, if fixed AND variable costs for a certain plant-plant combination should be respected in such a case, or only either of them.

column.name: MATERIAL_PACKAGE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_material_package_bs. Material Packaging type distinguished by SAP. Needed to differentiate bag vs bulk materials which both have the same Base UoM (tons) and are both e.g. going from Plant Siggenthal to Terminal Muenchenstein. The transfer (incl. handling) costs per ton are different between a 70 tons bulk wagon and a 20 pallets railcar.

column.name: VAR_IUD_COST
column.description: Current variable interunit-distribution costs (per 1 UOM), material-independent. These are costs caused when transporting material from one plant to another, independent of the material, but depending on the quantity. Material specific costs cannot be expressed in this table. IUD costs are only caused if the production and supply plants involved in an order_item are not identical.

column.name: FUTURE_VAR_IUD_COST
column.description: Future variable interunit-distribution costs (per 1 UOM), material-independent.

column.name: FUTURE_VALID_FROM_DAT
column.description: Validity start date of future_var_iud_cost. Current costs are valid until before future_valid_from_dat. Moving 'future' into 'current' and updating the future_valid_from_dat is a manual task, done once per year. Logon compares delivery date of order with this date and decides which cost is to be used.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency in which the interunit-distribution costs are expressed. Exchange rates in tlgnc_currency_exch_rate must be respected when adding costs of various sources in one order_item.
